controlledTests.originalChange: One obsolete all-Chat ban was narrowed to allow only Harbour/Care Chat page choices, retaining the other-three Chat/all-Photos bans and all-five Tasks identities.
controlledTests.negativeControl: The retained v105 app and v105 resolver both run, with their original catalog/actions imports. Shared session/frame-entry/boundary/HTML dependencies are byte-exact to v105.
controlledTests.limits: Real host, resolver, session, frame-entry and boundary code over controlled DOM, history, clipboard and transport ports. These tests do not execute React, browser layout, real Back/BFCache or accessibility engines.

minor.description: Equivalent Photos URL aliases now use the existing dedicated prohibition sentence instead of the generic not-ready sentence. Selection remains denied; no Photos runtime admission.

actualBrowser.scope: One bounded same-preview desktop Harbour/Care Chat design-selection pass.

firstOpen.screenshotScope: Visible layouts and conversation tail only; six messages per side were counted in rendered DOM, not all shown simultaneously in one screenshot.

readiness.geometryLimit: Rectangle and ancestry checks are not independent viewport-intersection proof; screenshots separately showed the layouts.

clipboardPaste.reason: No ordinary host-only paste destination was available. No fabricated input, clipboard injection, Chat composer interaction or copy-only status was substituted.

actualBrowser.directHiddenIdentityInspection: NOT_PERFORMED: current marker objects, accepted sequence numbers, frozen configuration and private document IDs were not directly read or changed.
actualBrowser.identityEvidence: Source review and controlled tests plus visible source diagnostics, exact receipts and actual lifecycle behavior. Not HTTP response-body hashing.
actualBrowser.duplicatePickInteraction: NOT_RERUN; covered by controlled tests only.
actualBrowser.postLoadPendingSelectorMutation: NOT_RERUN; covered by controlled tests only.
actualBrowser.confirmDialogs: Three Open clicks each timed out at an active confirmation dialog. Each current dialog was inspected and handled once; no uncertain click was blindly repeated.

notAcceptedOrNotRun: Fresh actual Chat clipboard paste, duplicate-pick interaction, or post-load pending-selector mutation.
Full 18-message history, pagination, editing, or conversation/content workflows.
Actual Original/Handbook/Fourth Chat designs or any Photos rendering/interaction.
Send, model/backend, attachment, voice, photo/file operations, or real family data.
Fresh mobile, keyboard, accessibility/screen-reader, gestures, zoom, or cross-browser matrix.
Sustained stability, Photos Chromium error9 cause or repair, or clock repair.
Production readiness, GCP deployment, or merge acceptance.

executionAndCleanup.localSetupFailures: Two launch preparations failed before Node/helper startup and before remote actions; subsequent corrected setup succeeded. These are not product failures.

notIncluded: Raw service/browser output, screenshots, private service/file identifiers or download links, credentials, machine paths, the deployment package, intermediate implementations, and the other 103 final-suite cases.
